scope: New 24-configuration performance search, not a factorial causal attribution experiment

core.state_training: debiased Sinkhorn, retained epsilon0.1 geometry, not assessment energy
core.state_reduction: Equal observed donor-guide laws in the logical batch; not target-macro or capture weighted
core.count_reduction: Equal fitting donors, each retaining the entire26504-category denominator including donors with no active sampled guide
core.endpoint_count_truth: Raw captured endpoint frequencies, observed zeros preserved, no endpoint pseudocount
core.complement: No positive-RNA source law: fixed mass multiplier1; no synthetic source state
core.estimator: Current active laws plus detached inactive fitness; full logical-batch normalizer and value-preserving sampling-scaled gradient

cache.write: Pre-update active rollout fitness after healthy accepted optimizer step

core.stabilization: State and nonreaction regularizers only; no mass, shape or molecular learning
core.joint_transition: Fresh Adam exactly once; healthy promoted trajectories preserve its state afterward

family_interpretation: F3 deliberately provides a molecular-supervised direct candidate beside molecular-supervised DDR. F3-versus-F1 is not an isolated target-conditioning test. F0 has no new auxiliary losses.

regularizers.target_regularization_note: New fixed shrinkage choice, not the historical embedding coefficient; penalizes the unscaled represented embedding rather than the nonidentified factor matrices separately
regularizers.direct_actions: Zero-noise anchor displacement, stochastic displacement around anchor, and particle log weight; integrate mixture actions with proposal correction rather than reaction-normalized weights
regularizers.DDR_actions: Mean squared drift, diffusion and reaction over eight steps

target_support.interpretation: Capped source support score, not an independent sample size or optimized statistical shrinkage

fold_scales.scope: Once per exact fitting subset and selected observation artifact; shared across all configurations and seeds on that subset
fold_scales.input_role: All admitted fitting-donor positive-RNA populations; the observation model technical holdout may enter post-selection dynamics/scales but never changes observation checkpoint selection
fold_scales.state_S0: Mean persistence Sinkhorn over all source/endpoint-paired fitting laws, using512 source draws and the full observed endpoint law
fold_scales.shape_scale: Mean persistence weighted Gaussian-mixture MMD2 over the same paired fitting laws, same512 source draws and full endpoint law; guide-law-equal reduction
fold_scales.effect_scale: Persistence early target-minus-pooled-NTC contrast versus observed late contrast MSE
fold_scales.molecular_target_reduction: Equal eligible guides within target, equal targets within fitting donor, equal donors
fold_scales.molecular_control_reduction: One pooled-NTC endpoint per donor, equal donors
fold_scales.molecular_effect_reduction: Same target reduction, retaining each donor's shared control dependence
fold_scales.source_draws: Fixed scale-purpose stateless keys, reused by all candidates; never candidate-output based
fold_scales.scale_value_rule: Finite and strictly positive; no silent epsilon floor, disabled loss or borrowed fold value
fold_scales.numerical_support_inventory: Must be published with each computed scale; any unavailable required term blocks that subset's main fitting
fold_scales.negative_roundoff_rule: Sinkhorn: preserve raw values; reject below-1e-5 and replace smaller-magnitude negatives by zero before the scale mean, retaining the historical numerical rule. FP64 MMD2/KL: preserve raw values and64*epsilon*max(1,sum_absolute_components) bound; only negative roundoff within that bound reports zero. Publish correction counts. Training losses remain unclipped.
fold_scales.normalizer_execution_budget: Separate pre-launch operation inventory still required; this rule file does not launch numerical scale calculation

shape.estimator: Weighted biased V-statistic MMD2, including self terms
shape.bandwidth_origin: Fixed prospective constants in standardized-coordinate units, not selected using any query outcomes
shape.pairwise_blocking: Exact weighted estimator evaluated in bounded blocks, no support truncation

molecular_companion.readout: Equal positive-RNA-cell compositions, averaged before natural log1p(10000*q); equal all-gene MSE on18129RNA features
molecular_companion.source_control: One pool of every positive-RNA source cell from the prespecified NTC catalog per donor, cell-equal
molecular_companion.endpoint_control: One pool of every positive-RNA endpoint cell from the same NTC catalog per donor, with actual endpoint RNA-cell composition
molecular_companion.prediction: Forecast the pooled source law with exact-zero target residual and normalize terminal particle weights across that pooled law
molecular_companion.complete_catalog_counts: Still use actual guide entries; the molecular pool is not an additional captured category
molecular_companion.missing_pool: Unavailable, never imputed or replaced by an endpoint-selected guide mixture
molecular_companion.control_loss_repetition: Once per donor, not once per target; contrast derivatives accumulate through the same control

common_query_support.forecast: Every query guide with positive Stim8hr RNA support, independent of endpoint support and fitting-target membership
common_query_support.unseen_target: Shared response for all families, exact-zero target residual inF3/F5
common_query_support.no_source_RNA: No state forecast; fixed-persistence count complement remains in complete catalog
common_query_support.endpoint_missing: Preserve forecast and count channel; explicitly unavailable state/molecular score

launch_requirements: Bound fold-native compiler and sampler with exact observation artifact and input identities
Computed fitting-only scales and support factors with complete inventories
Source-bound main CUDA precision, restart, memory and throughput qualification
Forecast/readout/reduction and selection operation inventory and storage contract
